reviews.comment: Her lectures weren't interesting, but it's a public speaking class and I don't think anyone could make a lecture over how to give speeches interesting. Four speeches that made up 70% of your grade and I think the rest was attendance and an exam. Exam was easy and speeches were fine as well but she might grade them a bit hard.

She's really sweet and understanding and her class is pretty chill. You do 4 speeches so that's most of your grade. As long as you actually put effort into what you write and how you present then you should end up doing well in her class. You only have one exam, and it's genuinely the easiest exam you'll ever take.

Lectures all class, kinda unless. No homework just have to complete speech outlines and write your speech. Pretty chill and nice just isn't anything special. Sometimes grades tough on speeches for no reason and sometimes doesn't. Pretty easy class overall though. Final was common sense questions
The lectures were mostly boring. Attendance is mandatory and there are a lot of mini assignments to do. Overall easy class & doing all the assignments will get you a good grade.

She is very dull and just reads straight off the slides. Makes it hard to learn. She's pretty understanding with students and accommodates well if students need extra time. She's not a hard grader. If you try and turn in the homeworks on time, you can get an A without doing too well on the exams. She's not too tough of a grader.

I do not know if the issue is the class or the professor. Part of your grade is attendance but going to class is a waste of time. She reads from the slides and barely brings in outside knowledge. The assignments and tests were easy but were not always practical. The class was easy but annoying.

Dr.Wesner is a pretty good professor I just think the course needs help. There are a ton of assignments due every week that are no help to exams or the group project. The exams are based off the textbook and the data analytics assignments are not the same. Her lectures are long and based off the slides.

This was one of the worst professors I have had in the business schools by far. I took her for MGMT 421 Management Data Analytics and Visualization Lots of homework, very boring and monotone. The lectures were unhelpful for exams and prepare to study really hard only to realize everything she taught wasn't really helpful.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I would take her again. She was better than her ratings. She curved at the end.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Wesner! Do your weekly readings & take your quizzes and you will be fine. Her tests are not open note but if you study a little bit, they are word for word from your notes/textbook and I did well on them. There are two projects, one in the first half and the other the second. You do a little bit of the project each week. Very easy.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I honestly loved Dr. Wesner! I enjoyed Comm 308 and what she taught. I thought the only hard thing was the tests but if you just put in the work to do the reviews which come straight from the powerpoints and just study that you can do well. The research assignments were so easy and help your grade so much. The quizzes are a breeze and are online!

She just read off the slides during lectures and added a few comments. Was kinda difficult to complete assignments because she doesn't give good instructions. A decent amount of research assignments, weekly packsacks, 3 exams, and optional final. She also rounded up my grade without me asking her to do so!

The class was about how to create charts and use data. It was really practical. I didn't expect to learn anything useful, but I learnt a lot of useful stuff. It was very interesting, too. It was kind of like we were making charts as an artist would.

Although this class was one of my hardest classes this semester, I loved taking it with Dr. Wesner. She is such a sweet lady & just wants you to succeed. Make sure to go to class & pay attention! Packbacks, quizzes, RA assignments, & exams all contribute to your grade, so if you are a bad test taker, you will succeed if you complete everything!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: If I could take Dr. Wesner again I would! This was one of my favorite classes by far, and although while it was a lot of work, it was very manageable. I think that Dr. Wesner made it as interesting as she could with the assignments and the packbacks. If you apply yourself and pay attention, you'll be okay.

She is a very kind person and means well but she is not the best professor. She never gave clear instructions for any assignment and everyone was always confused. Not even the TA's understood what the instructions were. You can pass with an A but prepared to be frustrated.

At times didn't clearly explain the steps on some of the projects and my class was a large class with several TA's and half the class was stressing out a lot on how to do things. Be sure to attend most of class days, pay attention to picture tutorials. Begin projects early. Prepare to install programs on computer. Lots of grades. Optional Final
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HER!! She never grades in a timely manner and is a very tough grader for such a basic class.

This was a difficult class, but Dr. Wesner did her best to make it bearable. It will take effort on your part to do well in the class. There was a lot of assignments and weekly quizzes. Worst part was the assignments which had very tedious and time consuming tasks. Tests were open book and weren't too hard, but you needed some prep to do well.
work load is more than any other class ive taken. weekly pack back discussion is required along with chapter quizzes and good luck on the test because the reviews do not help at all.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I was intimidated by the course initially because the workload seemed overwhelming but Dr. Wesner always provides all the material and resources that you need to get an A on any assignment. She always did her best to work with students + her and the TAs were very accessible outside of class. Wasn't a blow off class but definitely manageable!

Dr. Wesner is a very nice woman, but the way this class is structured is just so hectic and stressful. I have never experienced the stress that this class makes me feel. Many due dates have gotten pushed back because the class is confused. It would be helpful if Dr. Wesner was more clear about what would be on tests as well.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I actually really enjoyed this class. Go to class and participate and you will do well in the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Wesner's class was easy if you have experience in research or statistics. In person, her classes weren't engaging and just reading off a powerpoint. GO TO THE REVIEWS. She gives a lot of outside work to do that's fairly easy but time consuming. The TA's are super helpful.

Dr. Wesner is such an amazing and understanding person. Through the online transition she made sure to communicate with us and was overall one of my most understanding profs. Her projects and exams are a little tricky but study and you'll do fine.

Dr. Wesner is an amazing prof. She is fair and has great lectures. Cares a lot about her students, textbook is easy to read and helpful for exams. Lots of assignments to help your grade and very manageable. If you buckle down and study you can make an A on tests. They are difficult but fair. Highly recommend taking 308 with her.

Although the transition from face-to-face to online was tough (COVID-19), she really does things in favor of the students. This isn't the easiest class, but she is understanding and cares about her students. If you study well, go to class, and keep up with the projects you will do fine! Take advantage of her office hours and exam review sessions!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: She was a good prof but a little all over the place. Assignments were posted late and weekly quizzes were sometimes opened late. A lot of busy work and group projects.
This class had a lot of busywork, but if you follow the instructions, you will get an A on everything.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She does have 2 group projects that last the entire semester but if you have good team members you will do fine. She also allows time in class to work on them and ask her questions. I recommend reading the book because that helped me do well on the exams (3 with an optional final). The packback posts we do are boring but they are completion.

Dr. Wesner is a nice lady. However, I absolutely hated her course. Lectures are very boring and hard to pay attention to. Projects (2) aren't easy and take up the whole semester. Tests are hard. However, if you work your butt off you should pass, but I would not take 308 with her, take someone else!!

Dr. Wesner is absolutely AMAZING. These previous reviews do not do her or her class justice. She is one of the most caring and kind professors I have had and she genuinely cares about your success as a student. Willing to walk through material with you until you understand and very accessible. Helps you stay on top of what is due.

Wesner is a fine prof. Lectures from the ppt. Most of this class is group projects, but they are not that hard. My group got A's on both. There is LOTS of extra credit. Even with getting 70s on the tests, you are able to make an A in the class.

For COMM 203, we had four speeches and Dr. Wesner was great! COMM 203 at TAMU is hard in general because they have intentionally designed it that way. You definitely have to work at the class and your speeches. But Dr. Wesner is a great choice for the class compared to some of the others! Getting to know them personally can help as well.

Dr. Wesner is very unclear about grading criteria and what she expects from projects. My group, as well as many others, had no idea what to do on our projects that were worth a good chunk of our grade. This is the most disorganized class I have ever taken. She wasn't the worst, but I would not take her if you have other options.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Wesner is a pretty laid back professor who will easily extend deadlines for the projects. She can be unclear about what she wants out of the projects, but seemed to me to be an easy grader. She's super understanding of all of life's unexpected curveballs and wants to help her students outside of class in figuring out their future.
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took Dr Wesner for online comm 325 and it was super chill. Online quizzes due every week, a few easy assignments and a final at the end of the semester. Very laid back easy online class.

Attendance not mandatory, weekly online quizzes due monday am, pop quiz style mini projects for attendance/participation, only 2 exams and 1 optional final, 3 small/medium projects throughout semester that build on eachother, presentation at end of semester (conference style not in front of whole class), works with students for their success!!
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Pretty run of the mill online class, listen to lectures and do a quiz every week plus a final. Not bad or extremely difficult but the subject material is pretty interesting!

Of all the classes I have taken at TAMU Dr. Wesner is by far my favorite professor. I have learned so much from her. Her classes are revolved around the real world, all projects require working with real clients. She is a fair grader and is flexible with assignments.

The group project is long and hard, and that's assuming you got a good group. The lectures are boring and straight from the powerpoint. She makes you read the chapter and take a quiz before she ever lectures over it in class, which makes her lectures redundant and repetitive (and pointless). This class is way too content heavy. Good luck.

Wesner is incredibly disorganized and vague in her instructions. She assigns things last minute and has students do things that aren't in the syllabus or on ecampus so no one knows what to do. The group project isn't bad if you have a good group. Lectures are painful. One class she only said 24 words that weren't just reading off of the slides.

Her lectures are straight off the power point and monotone. Usually very confusing as to what she wants on her assignments. Her tests are very difficult. Took 3 classes from her and she does the same thing for everyone of her classes.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Her lectures were basically the readings in the book so class was pointless and added no new information. The grading criteria was never specific and often quite vague. She also did not do a great job of teaching us what was needed for the group project. Her ecampus page was also extremely difficult for students to navigate and could be confusing.

Her lectures after Exam one made no sense, I along with others in the class felt completely lost the whole time. The group project is so confusing and not well explained. I would avoid this class if you can.

This class is not as bad as people make it out to be! Your group is important so make sure you work to get a group of people who will work hard on your project! The tests are fair, not too hard. The key to success is really working hard on your research project and staying up with deadlines. Optional Final that can only help your grade!

This class is one big group project! Make sure that you get a good productive group( even through you can choose) and you select a client to work with! The beginning is lecture, reads off the powerpoint from the textbook. You don't need the book! Waste of money! Good class! Easy A

Dr. Wesner is alright, but she is a very boring lecturer. The whole semester you are working on a group project (you don't get to pick your groups) and its worth a lot of your grade. Optional final that replaces lowest test grade though!

Be prepared for group projects, which are assigned to you. If you get a bad group then it's pretty much too bad for you. The project wouldn't be so bad if it wasn't so detail oriented, there is a lot to do for them. The end of the semester will see a lot of work with stats so UGH. Weekly online quizzes, 5 minutes for 5 questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: To be honest, if you don't get a good group then you're out of luck. She assigns weekly work to your group project, so if you're the only one working in your group then this class is going to be MISERABLE. You can't pick your groups either, she does it randomly. Tests weren't bad, although one test was over 8 chapters aka insane. Daily pop quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Wesner is all over the place. She is extremely vague and the entire class is lost 90% of the time and she doesn't care. Attendance isn't technically mandatory, but there are questions every class for participation that effect your grade. There are only 2 tests and the second one has 8 chapters. Extremely time consuming and unnecessary, goodluck.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: The entire class is lost. Assigned a major group project on Tuesday, made it due on Sunday and wasn't even in the syllabus. I know grad students who have less work for their classes than this. It would be doable if she would just be clear about what's due, and when. Lectures are all over the place. COMM 308 is required for COMM majors so good luck
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Wesner is pretty cool if you sit down and talk with her, but her lectures are SO vague and confusing.  She's very unorganized and to be honest, my group and I agreed that we never knew what was going on lol.  You do actually conduct research in a group, but groups are assigned randomly, so good luck.  Take a different prof if you can.

Super super super vague about all the assignments, not helpful, and there is no adjustment into her class. You hit the floor running and lose about 10% of your grade if you get forced in on the last few days of add/drop week. Required, which sucks, and the class is super boring overall. Would not recommend
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Not a bad prof, but she reads straight off the slides. Usually gives out B's on the speeches unless you do really well
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Attendance technically isn't mandatory but there are Tophat questions every single class. Those grades add up. There's a group project but that's the whole point of the class. She can be a bit vague sometimes but if you go to her for clarification she's usually helpful. Definitely need to study for tests. I got Bs on both but class average was low
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Wesner was extremely fair and clear about what you needed to do in order to get an A in the class! Gave helpful feedback about what do to do to improve your speeches and genuinely cared about our ability to take public speaking outside the classroom! Not an easy A, but great prof and great class if you put in the work!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Wesner for COMM 315 online this summer and I would 100% recommend taking it if you need it. It's easy, informative and very interesting.

Werner is all over the place. I could never follow what she was saying. Clicker questions everyday and online quizzes every week. FIND A GOOD GROUP. Your grade depends on your group. The tests aren't bad though! I made a 90 on the first one, just make sure to read!
The class was mandatory. If you get a good group who is on top of things the course will be easier. Make good friends!
